title: Adaptive Depth & Layer Skipping Selection: LayerSkip Self-Speculative Decoding vs. Mixture-of-Depths (MoD) vs. Naive Early-Exit

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Naive Confidence Early-Exit at Layer 28 (Missing Layers 29..80 KV Cache!)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Anti-pattern for autoregressive LLMs (missing upper-layer KV states corrupt future tokens)

tiers.tier: Tier 2: KV-Propagation / State-Copying Early-Exit (Approximate Layers 29..80 KV)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Lossy heuristic (still loses -5.8 pts accuracy on multi-step reasoning)

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Pre-Trained Mixture-of-Depths (MoD 50% Per-Layer Token Capacity Router)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Custom pre-trained foundation models optimizing both Prefill FLOPs & KV Cache (-45%)

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): LayerSkip Self-Speculative Decoding (Draft 5 Tok at Layer 28 + Full 80-Layer Parallel Verify & KV Fill)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Production 100% lossless acceleration with 0.0 GB extra draft model VRAM
